# Observed fee regression inputs

Raw case, expected amount and receipt files are unchanged from the captured
Yearn fees benchmark at f3bb4bade3ba62ae24bb1af28f37d628447997eb.
Inventory metadata is a selected subset for the observed regression cases,
including older fee-evidence cases. Its discovery scope is limited to
that selected cohort. The manifest hashes identify these fixture files; the original
capture has its own provenance. Retired metadata and unavailable values
remain explicit. Verified execution evidence determines fee acceptance; benchmark estimates
remain
candidate amounts.
